p: Moore praised Lance's blocking and 'flipping finds' on plays where another receiver caught the ball. That is useful to the team but not a direct fantasy indicator.
I thought Bryce had a big block on the left side.
Will keep a significant offensive snap share as a reliable rookie receiver.
Played a lot of snaps, made big plays including a fourth-down catch, and Moore called him steady and reliable, which supports a real role.
